description: This file defines the internal class SimpleConsistentRingProvider, which assists in constructing and maintaining a consistent hash ring for silo management by finding and providing the successor silo in the ring based on hash codes, and keeping an up-to-date reference to it.

classes.name: SimpleConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to identify and track the successor silo in a consistent hash ring, updating the reference as the cluster state changes.

classes.name: SimpleConsistentRingProvider.VersionedSuccessor
classes.description: A helper nested class representing a versioned reference to a successor silo, including its membership version and address.

methods.name: SimpleConsistentRingProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with local silo details and cluster membership service, and determines the initial successor.

methods.name: Successor
methods.description: Property getter that retrieves the current successor, refreshing the reference if the cluster snapshot has advanced.

methods.name: FindSuccessor
methods.description: Internal method to compute the next silo in the hash ring based on the cluster snapshot.
